name: Niger-Congo (family node)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Niger-Congo (Atlantic-Congo) is the large African phylum whose Volta-Niger branch includes Yoruba and Igbo and whose Bantu branch is rooted separately at Proto-Bantu (bnt). It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the modern varieties that reference it have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table: a family node has no orthography of its own, and the ancestry metrics use only its classification and its ancestor links. A grapheme table belongs to a member language spec with a cited orthography.
